SK_Mon_Valdras.notes: Act boss of Chapter 1 (storyBoss). Clips in place (Walk play rate = v / ref). Idle = at attention, the sword planted. Attack01 = the two-hit combo (W1 damage at Contact 650; Contact2 1000 for W2). Attack02 = Banner Sweep, Cast01 = Oath-Brand slam, Lunge = P3 charge: [W2] skills with WindupEnd / Contact notifies (windups >= 700 ms). Roar = boss intro + phase changes (the standard flares). Death kneels (both knees, sword planted, helm bowed; the standard droops at Droop 1450); Rise = Death reversed (his spawn). Stun loops.
SK_Mon_Valdras.scaleNote: monsters.md 'Scale x1.4' is modelled into the mesh (manifest scale 1.0; the core sets no visual scale for the story boss): 2.10 m to the bare crown, 2.13 m to the helm (a head and a half over the 1.76 m hero, chapter1.md §11), x1.4 the hero's bulk (0.82 m pauldron span), ~2.65 m to the standard's finial (lowered 32 cm in review round 2; monsters.md 'about 2.4 m with the standard')
SK_Mon_Valdras.skeletonNote: SKEL_Human + tabard_f/b_01..02 (the warrior's / Unburied names, pelvis), standard_01..02 (spine_03: the pole grown through his back) and flag_01..03 (standard_02: the banner cloth) — new names, so the shared skeleton merges without a hierarchy clash

wind.required: prop cloth: AF_Wind must scale its sway by the baked weight (AF_Data.g on the toon, UVWind.U on the hull) — the height ramp alone sways the pole top and pins the tail
wind.uv1: UVWind: U = sway weight, V = phase (toon + hull loops: sway both alike)
wind.vertexColor: AF_Data.g = sway weight (0 rigid base .. 1 free tip), AF_Data.b = phase 0..1 (toon vertices; hull AF_Data.rgb = its normal)
wind.weightRule: 0 on the pole, crossbar, finial and base; cloth (and its trims / emblem) 0 at the bar -> 1 at the tail; phase per cloth panel + along its width

M_AF_AshDissolve.name: M_AF_AshDissolve
M_AF_AshDissolve.owner: A12 (vfx/fx_recipes_dark.py ASH_DISSOLVE, T_FX_AshNoise by vfx/fx_textures_dark.py); built by U3

Noise.map: object-space XZ / 60 cm (R fBm front, G cracks, B per-plate random)

timeline.burn: corpse.burn (a fire kill / fire over a corpse): the grey starts at once (no holdMs) under the flare and the crumble follows as usual; the husk is unraisable
timeline.crumble: then Dissolve 0 -> crumbleTo over crumbleMs: a pixel drops when (B x 0.6 + R x 0.3 + (1 - G) x 0.15 + heightFraction x 0.3) < Dissolve x 1.4 — whole plates (B dominates: ~12 cm flakes, never per-pixel grain), cracks first, upper parts before the lower; the surviving edge band EdgeWidth glows EdgeColor (pale ash, never warm). The recipe corpse.crumble plays at the start of the crumble
timeline.expire: at the TTL: Dissolve crumbleTo -> 1 over expireMs + corpse.expire
timeline.grey: after the Death clip ends + holdMs: toon colours lerp to AshColor (lit) / AshShade (shade band) over greyMs; emissive markers (violet eyes, seams) go out at the start of the grey
timeline.husk: the remaining ~62 % stays (ash-coloured, no ink fade) until the TTL
timeline.rise: monster.raise: Dissolve and grey reverse over the Rise clip's first 60 %

M_AF_AshDissolve.use: U3 corpses in ash mode: the death pose holds, the body turns to ash and crumbles into a husk that keeps its place for the corpse TTL (20 s), then blows away; Rise reverses it. Applied to every toon slot of the character (the ink hull follows the same mask so no ink floats over dissolved parts)

contact.look: at Progress 1 the fill jumps to FrontColor alpha fillAlpha and the rim to #FF3A48, then everything fades out over fadeMs; the recipe telegraph.contact (or .line / .cone) plays at the same instant for the dust and the rim snap. The fill stays translucent (VFX r5: bone at .26 rising to a .45 flash read as a near-opaque white paving over the ground and the hero's feet at 760-900 ms); the bright front band and the urgency pulse carry the read

M_AF_Telegraph.name: M_AF_Telegraph
M_AF_Telegraph.owner: A12 (vfx/fx_recipes_dark.py TELEGRAPH, textures by vfx/fx_textures_dark.py); built by U2
previews: Previews/vfx_effects/telegraph.contact*/*.png, hazard.*/*.png, death.cinderbloat/*.png, elite.fire_enhanced.death/*.png (the material emulated per pixel on the march ground; styles normal / boss / hazard / arena / elite; index: Previews/vfx_effects/README_dark.md)
M_AF_Telegraph.progress: Progress = (now - startMs) / (contactMs - startMs), clamped: the fill grows from the origin (circle, cone, ring: radially to Progress x radius; line: along the length to Progress x length) with a bright front band FrontWidthCm wide at its edge; fill alpha lerps FillAlphaStart -> FillAlphaContact (low on purpose: translucency blends in linear light, so bone at alpha .5 over the #3A332D mud already reads as an opaque pale paving that hides the ground). The fill reaches the rim exactly at the contact beat (monsters.md 1.3)
M_AF_Telegraph.rules: crimson + bone only — no hero recipe draws a filling ground shape (hue audit fill rule); enemy magic that is not a damage hazard stays breach-violet

shapes.cone: the circle of radius clipped to |angle(p - origin, dir)| <= arcDeg / 2 (the edges are rim too)
shapes.line: the box origin -> origin + dir x length, half-width width / 2 (rounded far end)
shapes.ring: d = max(|p - origin| - radius, innerRadius - |p - origin|)

arena.map: the damage is OUTSIDE the boundary (EvArena, e.g. Valdras P3's closing banner ring: 4 % max life per second outside it): Rim V = the OUTWARD distance from the boundary / RimWidthCm, so the scorched line sits on the boundary and the 45-degree hatch band fades outward, into the side that hurts; outside the rim a faint flat wash of RimColor at outerWash.alpha (ramping in over fadeInCm) — no fill sweep, no bone; inside stays clean
arena.note: an arena boundary (EvArena): which side hurts must read without the recipe — crimson rim, hatch facing outward, a faint crimson wash outside; the fire wall on the edge is hazard.banner_ring

boss.note: bosses: the widest rim, the inner rim, urgency from half the windup

elite.note: a second, thinner rim inside: elites telegraph the same hue with more ink

hazard.note: a lingering zone (EvHazard): rim only; what burns inside is the hazard.* recipe
hazard.window: on for the zone's whole damage window: a hazard that follows a windup (the breach-seep's line) keeps its crimson line from the windup's contact until the zone ends (its last tick), fading out over fadeMs — the decal hands over from its windup style, it never drops to violet only while it still hurts

Fill.map: world XY / FillTileCm (never the shape's UV, so the grain does not swim with progress); colour = FillColor x (1 - FillGrain x (1 - tex.rgb)) (at full strength the plate edges read as flagstone paving; .3 keeps a grain, not plates)

Rim.map: U = arc length along the boundary / RimTileCm; V = (inward distance to the boundary) / RimWidthCm; colour = RimColor x tex.rgb, opacity = tex.a x RimAlpha

M_AF_Telegraph.urgency: over the last 30 % of the windup the rim alpha pulses x (0.82 + 0.18 sin(2 pi t / 0.18 s))
M_AF_Telegraph.use: the enemy damage telegraph ground decal (U2 AbyssTelegraphs: EvTelegraph shape / start / contact / style; EvHazard zones in the hazard style, EvArena boundaries in the arena style). One pooled ground quad per telegraph, 8 cm over the terrain (the ground-lift rule of the sprite quads), translucent, unlit, no depth fade, sorted over the ground decals

color.formula: out = srgb_to_linear(mix(ink, line(c), o)); line(c) = mix(mix(c, lineTint, lineTintMix), 0, lineDarken); c = T_AF_Palette_BC(uv) (sRGB values), o = T_AF_Palette_P(uv).a
color.note: mix(ink, line(c), o) is never lighter than line(c); ink classes keep hull lum <= 40 (o <= 0.4)

outline.model: inverted hull baked into every mesh (P7/R3): material slot 1 M_AF_Outline, unlit, opaque, default back-face culling (the hull's winding is flipped, so its far side draws the rim); same skin weights

formula: depth = TransformPosition(P, World->View).z  (= dot(P - CameraPosition, CameraForward))
wpo.meaning: the hull's far side = the body silhouette dilated by OutlinePx1080 * ViewSizeY / 1080 pixels in screen space (clip-space extrusion along the normalised projected normal)
wpo.mobileLow: WPO off: the baked width alone (hero 1.8 cm = 2.16 px at the default distance)

params.TanHalfFOV.y: ViewProperty 'Tan(0.5 x FieldOfView)'.y = tan(FOVx/2) * ViewSizeY / ViewSizeX

wpo.preview: kit.outline.set_preview_screen (Geometry Nodes, same formula per vertex)

rim.formula: alpha * smoothstep(band0, band1, (1 - max(N.V, 0))^power) * smoothstep(0, maskEdge, N.L)

details.cells: 4 x 4 cells of one tile: row 0 grass, 1 dirt, 2 stone, 3 camp (paint 5); column = variant - 1 (variants 1..3); column 3 (water) is transparent: lily pads are the instanced lily_pad_plains@march meshes (dead reeds, oily scum: SM_Foliage_March_Reeds_A/B) (spec 6.1)
details.rule: own tile (nearest centre) h = tileHash(col, row, 7): h % 12 >= 6 -> variant 1 + h % 3; sample cell at frac(UV0 + 0.5) (tile-local 0..1); composite over the winning material only when it is the own tile's material (AF_Terrain _pattern_block own_var / own_m)

channels.g: the same field pre-offset for m = 1
channels.r: latNoise(u + .5, v + .5) * .5 + .5 (period 3) — transition wobble: score += 0.3 * (2r - 1) with u, v offset by (m * .37, -m * .61) per material m

noise.shared: theme-independent (the AF_Terrain lattice / patch fields): the plains noise texture
noise.use: mobile / low quality: replaces the 12-sine analytic noise of AF_Terrain

march.source: Data/terrain_styles.json themes.march (core lane, chapter1.md §15; the runtime Tile<i>* vectors) + the march art extras painted into the textures (terrain_march.py)
transitions: per pixel: the 4 tiles round its tile corner, w = (1 - d^2)^2 (d = distance to the tile centre), normalised per material
score s = w_norm + rank * 0.025 + 0.3 * noise_m; winner t1, runner-up t2, delta = s1 - s2
coverage a = 1 if delta >= 0.025 else 0.5 + delta / 0.05 (crisp anti-aliased cel edge)
t1 liquid: shallow tint (1 - smoothstep(.5, .95, w1)) * .75 toward WaterShallow; foam WaterFoam where delta < .065: (1 - delta / .065)^.6 * .92
t2 liquid: bank WaterBank .7 * (1 - delta / .045) for delta < .045, then .25 * (1 - (delta - .045) / .055) up to .1
rank1 > rank2: lip (Tile<i>Lip, else base + 25 % toward #FFF2D6) at .75 for delta < .032
rank1 < rank2: dark edge #241A3A at .2 * (1 - delta / .055) for delta < .055
walls paint the dominant ground (grass), camp walls camp ground; vertex G (wall coverage) darkens x (.62,.66,.6) * .45; vertex B (skirt) * .86
march.uv: UV0 = tile space (col, row; tile centre at integers); layer textures repeat every 3 tiles: sample at UV0 / 3, wrap, bilinear + mips (flat toon colour, no noise)

details.cells: 4 x 4 cells of one tile: row 0 grass, 1 dirt, 2 stone, 3 camp (paint 5); column = variant - 1 (variants 1..3); column 3 (water) is transparent: lily pads are the instanced SM_Foliage_Plains_LilyPad_A/B meshes only (spec 6.1)
details.rule: own tile (nearest centre) h = tileHash(col, row, 7): h % 12 >= 6 -> variant 1 + h % 3; sample cell at frac(UV0 + 0.5) (tile-local 0..1); composite over the winning material only when it is the own tile's material (AF_Terrain _pattern_block own_var / own_m)

channels.g: the same field pre-offset for m = 1
channels.r: latNoise(u + .5, v + .5) * .5 + .5 (period 3) — transition wobble: score += 0.3 * (2r - 1) with u, v offset by (m * .37, -m * .61) per material m

noise.use: mobile / low quality: replaces the 12-sine analytic noise of AF_Terrain

plains.source: Data/terrain_styles.json themes.plains (same colours as the runtime Tile<i>* vectors)
transitions: per pixel: the 4 tiles round its tile corner, w = (1 - d^2)^2 (d = distance to the tile centre), normalised per material
score s = w_norm + rank * 0.025 + 0.3 * noise_m; winner t1, runner-up t2, delta = s1 - s2
coverage a = 1 if delta >= 0.025 else 0.5 + delta / 0.05 (crisp anti-aliased cel edge)
t1 liquid: shallow tint (1 - smoothstep(.5, .95, w1)) * .75 toward WaterShallow; foam WaterFoam where delta < .065: (1 - delta / .065)^.6 * .92
t2 liquid: bank WaterBank .7 * (1 - delta / .045) for delta < .045, then .25 * (1 - (delta - .045) / .055) up to .1
rank1 > rank2: lip (Tile<i>Lip, else base + 25 % toward #FFF2D6) at .75 for delta < .032
rank1 < rank2: dark edge #241A3A at .2 * (1 - delta / .055) for delta < .055
